name: echo sleepy
description: Proposal, a mood for the idle rotation on the 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x), mostly still with long holds: the creature rests and blinks, yawns with its visor stretching tall, its eyes squeezed to short lines and a dark round mouth opening in the band while it rises a row, then its lids come down in three slow steps to a closed line, its head sinks two rows with the antenna tipping forward and a pale sleep bubble swelling at the side of its head, until the bubble pops and it jolts a row taller with wide eyes and a pinging antenna, settles and blinks back to rest; judge whether the tall visor reads as a yawn, whether the three lid steps read as drowsy rather than as a glitch, and whether it is still this creature.
